newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran detonates nearly million mines - commander.
newsitem.headline: Iran detonates nearly million mines - commander.

text.p: Nearly a million mines and hundreds of thousands of unexploded shells left over from the 1980-88 Iran-Iraq war have been detonated in Iran's southern regions, a senior officer said in remarks reported on Wednesday.

The acting commander of the army's ground forces, identified by Iran's official news agency IRNA as Brigadier-General Darjazi, said on Tuesday night 480,000 anti-personnel mines, 175,000 anti-vehicle mines, 291,000 anti-tank mines and 377,000 unexploded shells had been collected and detonated.
The bodies of 434 Iraqi soldiers recovered in search operations had been delivered to Iraqi officials, he said.
International experts say as many as 20 million land mines sown both by Iranian and Iraqi forces during the conflict still dot border areas.
